  • ImageDrawing
  • LinearProgressIndicator Compose splits determinate from indeterminate by whether the `progress` argument is there at all, so the override writes the two calls rather than choosing a number for "unknown".
  • Link A link as a Compose button: `to` is the page's record and `params` what it is handed, null for the page's own -- the route's default.
  • OutlinedTextField `label` is the floating caption, and it is a slot rather than a prop because Compose takes content there, not text.
  • RadioButton

  • SnglDateField A field a date is typed into, with a button opening Material's date picker.
  • SnglImage
  • SnglRemoteImage
  • SnglScroll SnglScroll is a scroll: a column scrolled vertically, reporting its end coming into view.
  • SnglSelect SnglSelect is a select: a read-only field showing the label chosen, which a tap opens a menu of the choices from.

  • drawSource The primitive a `canvasImage` paints its source through.
  • markup.image Compose has `InlineTextContent` for a picture on the line with the words, and it needs a painter per source -- the same thing `ui.image` has no answer for on this platform.
  • markup.link Compose 1.7 gives an `AnnotatedString` real links: `withLink` makes the run tappable and `Text` follows it.

  • ui.badge
  • ui.button
  • ui.card A clickable card is Material's clickable Card, the overload taking `onClick`, which gives it the ripple and the focus stop a pressable surface has; any other card is the plain one, which a press passes through.
  • ui.checkbox
  • ui.datepicker A date is typed as YYYY-MM-DD, or picked in Material's dialog from the button beside the field.
  • ui.divider
  • ui.drawer
  • ui.file
  • ui.hbox
  • ui.image An image is a box holding the source it shows, or the placeholder where it holds none, and it hands its source the two events it reports: a picture arriving and one failing.
  • ui.input The placeholder is Compose's floating `label`.
  • ui.link
  • ui.menu
  • ui.menubar
  • ui.modal
  • ui.popover
  • ui.progress Compose's determinate/indeterminate split is by *presence* of the `progress` argument, which is the shape `value` being an `option` gives the override: the null test picks the call, and neither branch invents a fraction.
  • ui.radio Compose's RadioButton is one option, so the group is the loop: the container is the direction the prop asks for and each option is a button beside its label.
  • ui.remote
  • ui.scroll
  • ui.select The menu's open state is SnglSelect's own, in Kotlin, as a datepicker's dialog is: an override declaring a var gets one cell per call site, and a select inside a `for` is many selects.
  • ui.spacer
  • ui.spinner
  • ui.splitview
  • ui.stack
  • ui.table A table is a column of rows, the headings first and then each row's cells, every cell an equal share of its row so that it lines up under its heading.
  • ui.tabs Material's TabRow of a Tab per tab, and the selected one's content under it.
  • ui.text
  • ui.textarea
  • ui.toggle
  • ui.toolbar
  • ui.tooltip
  • ui.tree
  • ui.vbox
  • ui.window The window's `@error` is the outermost boundary of what it renders, and catches whether or not the call site handles one.

  • buildApk Builds the project in dir into a debug APK at out.
  • composeColor Fully qualified rather than imported: this platform's own emitter already writes `import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color as ComposeColor`, so the bare name is not bound and an import of it would collide with that alias.

  • drawRectFill Each shape below draws at most twice, once per paint that is visible: a transparent fill or stroke is not painted at all rather than painted with nothing, which is what the alpha tests say.
  • drawRectStroke
  • drawTextShim The two drawings a native declaration cannot describe: text reaches a `Paint` by chained property access and an image goes through a safe-call chain ending in a `let`.
  • f32 SNGL's `float` is a Kotlin `Double` and Compose's geometry is `Float`, so the conversion is written where the value crosses.

  • install Builds the project in dir, makes sure a device is attached -- starting an emulator where none is -- installs the APK, launches it and follows its log until it exits.

  • rect Compose's `Path.arcTo` takes a bounding box and two angles in *degrees*, where the command gives three points and a radius -- so the corner is solved by `sngl:ui/draw` and only the box and the degrees are built here.
  • rememberScrollState A scroll position kept across recompositions.
  • send
  • size
  • strokeCap The names are SNGL's and the values Compose's, the same mapping gtk4 writes for cairo's enums.
  • strokeJoin
  • strokeOf Compose's `Stroke` carries the cap and the join, so `strokeStyle` takes the whole style rather than just the width -- android read `lineCap` and `lineJoin` nowhere before this and the two reached its `Style` data class to be ignored (#223).
  • strokeStyle
  • permission A permission the app asks for wherever the marked declaration is reached: `#[permission("android.permission.INTERNET")]` on the native an override calls, so the manifest asks for what the program uses and nothing else.
